steps.title: Hash Implementation
steps.description: Implement unsigned long djb2(string s) with hash=5381, then for each char: hash = hash*33 + c. Test with 'hello', 'world', 'hello' (same hash for same string).
hints: unsigned long hash = 5381; for (char c : s) hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + c;

verification.failureMessage: Print hashes of hello twice (should match)
